content.short: Bithumb is a South Korean cryptocurrency exchange.
content.description: Bithumb, a cryptocurrency exchange based in South Korea, provides a platform where users can buy, sell, trade, deposit and withdraw cryptocurrency. These activities are carried out directly on Bithumb, reflecting its role as a practical venue for handling digital assets through a single service. For developers, API access is available after configuring an accessible IP address, enabling withdrawals to their address via the API. This setup combines user-facing functionality with API-enabled withdrawal capabilities.
